sn56.20:1.3: Idaṃ dukkhan ti bhikkhave tatham etam avitatham etam anaññatatham etaṃ || || 4.
sn56.20:1.4: Ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo ti tatham etaṃ avitatham etam anaññatham etaṃ || || 5.
sn56.20:1.5: Ayaṃ dukkhanirodho ti tatham etaṃ avitatham etam anaññatham etaṃ || || 6.
sn56.20:1.6: Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti tatham etam avitatham etam anaññatham etaṃ || || 7.
sn56.20:1.7: Imāni kho bhikkhave cattāri tatthāni avitathāni anaññathāni || ||
sn56.20:2.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave idaṃ dukkhan ti yogo karaṇīyo || la-pa || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yogo karaṇī yoti || ||
